page.overview:
Who is Doctor Koplenson?

Doctor Koplenson was one of the administrators at Smith's Grove Sanitarium. He was present during Michael Myers' parole hearing and agreed with his peers to deny Michael's parole. When Michael broke out of Smith's Grove, Koplenson telephoned Michael's caretaker, Dr. Samuel Loomis to inform him of the massacre left behind in Michael's wake.
